bootstrap.scope: Primary Gemma 4 comparisons against retained production outputs. Astra supplementary lower bounds use the same per-comparison cutoff outside the primary families.
bootstrap.margin_interpretation: One F1 percentage point is a planning convention, not an established operational tolerance. The unrounded adjusted lower bound must be strictly greater than -1 pp; failing to clear it is inconclusive.
bootstrap.uncertainty_scope: Paired-record uncertainty conditional on the evaluated predictions. Does not cover training variance, retrospective prompt/selection choices, distribution change or annotation uncertainty.

selection.primary: maximum generated validation canonical micro-F1 rounded to four decimal places on the 0–1 scale; ties: higher validation strict record exact-match count, then earlier step
selection.sensitivity: minimum validation loss; ties: earlier step
selection.oracle: maximum observed test F1; descriptive only
selection.prior_adapters_and_proxies: retained maximum-test-F1 checkpoints; descriptive references only

f1_rounding.method: Python round on the scorer value (nearest, ties to even)

tie_breakers: higher validation strict record exact-match count
selection.final_checkpoint_baseline: Final saved checkpoint at step 2298 after six epochs; a no-selection baseline, not an early-stopping run.

validation_resampling.procedure: Reapply the same rounded validation-F1 and tie-break rule to retained per-record validation counts, then map the selected step to its retained sweep test F1.
validation_resampling.scope: Sensitivity to the retained validation sample, not independent validation or new inference/training. The analysis reuses the same rows and four primary seed-42 sweeps only; the separate seed-43 replicate is not included.

second_seed_replicate.comparison: Same validation-loss, final-checkpoint, validation-F1 and observed-test-oracle rules as the four primary sweeps.
second_seed_replicate.scope: One replicate of one run on the same split. Not an independent holdout, not a primary precision comparison and not part of the primary validation resampling. Its exploratory paired-record CI does not measure training-seed variation.

scope: Separate JO and FT primary families retain divisor 9; six completed cells in each. Astra supplementary bounds and same-precision proxy comparisons are outside these families. No adjustment corrects retrospective analysis choices or test-based reference checkpoint selection.

same_precision_proxy_comparisons.reference: Same-prompt local Llama 3.1 8B proxy at the matching serving precision
same_precision_proxy_comparisons.candidate_selection: maximum generated validation canonical micro-F1 rounded to four decimal places on the 0–1 scale; ties: higher validation strict record exact-match count, then earlier step
same_precision_proxy_comparisons.scope: Exploratory paired comparisons outside the primary families. Intervals do not correct for test-based proxy checkpoint selection. Retain paired contrasts rather than subtracting rounded quality rates.

error_analysis.comparison: Canonical field outcomes on the common test set, comparing each candidate with production.
error_analysis.loss_definition: Nonempty gold value, correct production output and incorrect candidate output; spurious predictions with empty gold are counted separately.
error_analysis.relation_normalization: Uppercase forms with non-alphanumeric characters removed.
error_analysis.shared_losses: Records both precisions lose; identical output means the same canonical string.
error_analysis.scope: Counts of first-match string relations, not independent causes, hallucination diagnoses or evidence that gold labels are wrong. Excludes errors shared with production from the loss taxonomy. Released results contain aggregates only.

hosted_evaluation.ten_shot_selection: The same ten training examples for both ten-shot settings, chosen deterministically and excluding descriptors present in validation or test.
hosted_evaluation.scope: A dated hosted evaluation at one reasoning setting; the model alias does not identify an immutable provider revision. Supplementary comparisons remain outside the primary prompt families.
